title: Senior Software Engineering Lead - Java FSE
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 A highly experienced Full Stack Engineer with 10\+ years of expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Kafka, and Cloud Platforms (GCP/Azure), responsible for designing, developing, and supporting scalable, high\-performance enterprise applications.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade applications using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Build and optimize event\-driven and real\-time data processing solutions using Apache Kafka, ensuring scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance
* Lead architecture discussions and contribute to technical design, solutioning, and technology roadmaps
* Develop secure, reusable, and high\-quality code following industry best practices, coding standards, and design patterns
* Implement and manage cloud\-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure, leveraging services for compute, storage, networking, and monitoring
* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Drive application modernization initiatives, including migration from monolithic systems to microservices and cloud platforms
* Ensure application reliability through performance tuning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support activities
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and DevOps best practices to accelerate software delivery
* Mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and promote engineering excellence across development teams
* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and operational standards while delivering resilient and scalable solutions
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to planning, estimation, and successful project execution
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in software design, development, and support of enterprise applications
* Solid expertise in Java/J2EE, including Core Java, Multithreading, Collections, JVM tuning, and design patterns
* Extensive experience developing microservices\-based applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and RESTful APIs
* Proven experience implementing event\-driven architectures using Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, Kafka Streams, topic management, and performance tuning
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure, including deployment, monitoring, and cloud\-native services
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* Experience in Agile/Scrum development methodologies and working within cross\-functional teams
* Solid knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or BigQuery
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, resilience, security, and performance optimization
* Proven excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills
* Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with technical and business stakeholders
* Skills \& Competencies:
+ Solid expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, and Kafka
+ Hands\-on experience with GCP and/or Azure cloud services
+ Experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevOps practices
+ Solid understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture, and event\-driven design
+ Proven excellent problem\-solving, leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills

* Leadership Expectations:
+ Ability to lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and design decisions
+ Experience mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving engineering best practices
+ Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high\-quality, scalable, and reliable solutions
+ Solid collaboration and stakeholder management skills in a fast\-paced enterprise environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Relevant cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Google Professional Cloud Developer, Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, ARM Templates, or Bicep)
* Experience in cloud migration, modernization, and application transformation initiatives
* Experience with API gateways, service mesh technologies, and event streaming platforms
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, or Cloud Monitoring
* Exposure to AI/ML\-enabled products, data engineering pipelines, or large\-scale analytics platforms


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone \- of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income \- deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: BC SECTOR-TMT-BPI-Senior
description:

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**OSS Technology Consultant – Blue Planet Inventory (BPI) \- Senior**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 In this role, as a senior consultant in GDS Consulting, you will lead the implementation of Ciena/ Blue Planet products and integration with the telecommunications operators’ Operations Support Systems (OSS). You will be responsible for ensuring that a quality, integrated software solution is delivered in a timely manner, at budget, and to our client's satisfaction.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery and Product implementation, configuration, extensions, and integrations for OSS systems involving Ciena Blue Planet’s suite of products with specific focus on Blue Planet Network Inventory (BPI).
* Actively drive \& participate in Business Analysis and requirements gathering, Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, Data Migration and Support.
* You will develop system, process and data requirements of the customer.
* You will map OSS software (Network Inventory) capabilities to those needs and build consensus around the solution, proposes technical solutions to system requirements.
* You will develop applicable process and system change documentation; Develop and distribute project related documentation.
* Write and maintain Java code, create Spring beans, and develop JUnit tests.
* Develop and extend GUI components such as grids and reports using core product modules.
* Adhere to established coding and documentation standards while extending core product components.
* Write and optimize database queries and procedures, primarily for Neo4j, PostgreSQL.
* Support debugging, deployment, and environment setup using tools and platforms such as Docker, AWS, and Kubernetes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong technical skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.


**Frontend Development:**
* Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SVG
* Frameworks/Libraries: Angular 2\+, Node.js/npm, Gulp
* Testing: Protractor, Jasmine


**Backend Development:**
* Languages: Java 11\+, J2EE
* Frameworks/Libraries: Maven, Spring (Data, Security, MVC), SpringBoot
* Testing: JUnit


**Databases:**
* Primary: Neo4j (Graph DB), PostgreSQL \+ TimescaleDB


**Additional Skills:**
* ElasticSearch, Camunda / BPMN / OSM / Workflow, Drools, Kafka integration, RESTful APIs (using Spring MVC), Docker, Kubernetes
* Programming Concepts: Algorithms, data structures, database concepts (relational and graph)


**Domain Knowledge:**
* Telecom, OSS (Operational Support Systems), Inventory Management
* Consultant with minimum of 5\+ Years proven experience and significant knowledge in Telecom OSS Network Inventory.
* Experience in Ciena Blue Planet Inventory (BPI).
* Experience in at least one of the OSS COTS products (E.g. Netcracker, Ericsson, Nokia, etc.)
* Knowledge of and preferably certification in TMForum’s eTOM framework along with Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and Open APIs.
* Exceptional quantitative skills enabling identification of key business issues and progression of solutions.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Technical Lead
description:
****Job Description****
**Technical Lead**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Shift:** 
 1 PM – 10 PM IST
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8\+ years
   

  

****Position Overview****
 We are looking for a Technical Lead to drive a scrum team for all necessary deliverables and serve as the technical face of the team for major decisions. This position will be based in our Pune office and work closely with product, engineering leadership, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver on the Momentive Careers roadmap.
   

  

****Position Summary****
 As a Technical Lead, you will be responsible for driving a scrum team to deliver project commitments and orchestrating complex application development across the full lifecycle — from concept through post\-production support and maintenance of server, OS, web applications, and services. You will oversee application code development, contribute to and manage version\-controlled source code repositories, and lead assigned tasks to create measurable value using industry\-recognized agile methodologies and best practices. You will advocate the architecture standards and guidelines set by engineering leadership, and must demonstrate quality, brevity, and timeliness in all deliverables.
   

  

****About Us:****
 Momentive Software is a 40\+ year leader in technology for mission\-driven organizations. We serve over 37,000 nonprofits, associations, and professional communities — helping them fundraise, manage members, run events, deliver learning, and connect their industries with talent. Trusted by organizations like Girl Scouts, Habitat for Humanity, and ASAE, our unified platform replaces the patchwork of disconnected tools that hold mission\-driven organizations back.
   

  

 Our purpose: power the future of mission\-driven organizations by unifying the tools they need into one intelligent software system. That includes MomentiveIQ — our AI\-powered workflow automation layer — across a portfolio of 10\+ integrated solutions.
   

  

****About Product – Momentive Careers:****
 Momentive Careers is the industry's most trusted career center platform, with over 20 years of continuous innovation in the association job board market. We power the largest association network job board in the world. Associations use Momentive Careers to deliver a high\-value member service, acquire and engage new members, and generate non\-dues revenue by connecting their industries' employers with qualified talent.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
**In This Role, You Will:**
* Manage a scrum team to deliver project deliverables on time and serve as the primary technical decision\-maker for the team
* Successfully run Agile ceremonies and work closely with Product Owners to keep the roadmap and team capacity in balance
* Educate and mentor engineers across the team; participate in on\-call duties for production issues as required
* Develop application code according to requirements — hands\-on across PHP, Lucee, and React layers
* Contribute to lifecycle flow and value streams by prescribing and following engineering methodologies and best practices
* Solve the most difficult software development challenges across backend, frontend, and data layers
* Maintain a balance of business and technical acumen in all decision\-making
* Contribute to source\-code management and work item tracking best practices
* Drive estimation during sprint planning and PI planning exercises
* Provide technical consultation to the engineering management team
* Contribute across all SDLC phases: design reviews, writing user stories, code reviews, and automated testing
* Champion architecture standards and engineering guidelines set by technical leadership


****Experience****
**We Are Looking for Someone Who Brings**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
* 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 4 years on PHP\-based SaaS applications
* 2–4 years of experience leading and managing a scrum team


****Must\-Have Skills****
* Strong knowledge of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID principles, and SOA design
* Deep PHP proficiency — Zend / Laminas Framework required
* Hands\-on experience with Lucee (CFML) for server\-side rendering
* 3\+ years working with React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and Redux Saga
* Strong command of REST API design, development, and integration
* Solid SQL skills — MS SQL and MySQL (query optimization, schema design)
* Experience with caching and queuing: Redis, RabbitMQ
* TDD experience — PHPUnit, Jest, or Selenium; able to write and enforce unit and integration test standards
* Agile / SAFe development experience; proficient with Jira for sprint and backlog management
* Strong Git and version control practices — Bitbucket or GitHub
* A self\-starter who can work independently within a globally distributed team
* Understanding of emerging AI tools in support of engineering best practices — GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.


****Good\-to\-Have Skills****
* AWS experience — deploying and managing cloud infrastructure
* Experience building and operating microservices architectures
* Elasticsearch or Solr — query tuning and index management
* GraphQL API design and consumption
* Docker, Kubernetes — container\-based deployment
* Python (Celery) for background task processing
* Enterprise\-level APM experience — New Relic preferred
* MongoDB experience


**Tech Stacker**
**Backend:** 
 PHP 8, Zend / Laminas Framework, Python, Celery, Lucee (CFML), REST APIs
   

  

**Frontend:** 
 Lucee (CFML), React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Redux Saga, HTML5, CSS3
   

  

**Data \& Search:** 
 MS SQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Solr / SolrCloud, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ
   

  

**Infrastructure:** 
 AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, New Relic, Git, Linux
   

  

****Good People, Doing Good Things:****
 At Momentive Software we are engineers, problem\-solvers, and people who genuinely care about the organizations we serve. We dream big, invest in each other's growth, and build technology that makes a measurable difference. We look forward to you being part of our story.

Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

title: FDE Agentic Operations Engineer
description:
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2\-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person.
   





**About SailPoint** 




 SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI\-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non\-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots. Built on core principles like zero\-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.
 



  

**About the role** 




 As an FDE Agentic Operations Engineer, you will operate at the cutting edge of AI and identity security, bridging Forward Deployed Engineering, Solution Engineering, Professional Services, and Product Management. In your day\-to\-day work, you will own the end\-to\-end execution of AI\-assisted migration pipelines and demo environments. You will ingest complex customer identity artifacts, steer advanced multi\-agent workflows, troubleshoot model outputs, and perform hands\-on configuration within SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC). You will blend technical rigor with agentic tooling to accelerate customer time\-to\-value, validate AI\-generated artifacts against real tenant behavior, and establish new standards for identity modernization.
 



  
 



**About the team** 




 You will join the Forward Deployed Engineering / Agentic Operations team, a high\-impact technical group dedicated to accelerating customer onboarding and modernization through state\-of\-the\-art AI automation. Our team builds, refines, and operates intelligent agentic pipelines that transform legacy identity environments into modern cloud architectures, collaborating closely with cross\-functional partners across Sales, Product, and Engineering.
 



  
 **Roadmap for success** 




  
 



**30 days:** 



* Complete SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) and IdentityIQ (IIQ) foundational product training and internal onboarding.
* Shadow senior engineers on active agentic workflows and AI\-assisted identity migration runs.
* Execute standard LLM and multi\-agent migration pipelines, interpret model outputs, and log issues with structured diagnostic context.



  
 



**60 days:** 



* Independently operate AI\-driven modernization pipelines to process customer IAM data extracts and artifacts.
* Perform hands\-on verification and remediation in SailPoint ISC tenant configurations, including sources, schemas, identity profiles, and lifecycle states.
* Identify and correct AI hallucinations, incomplete configurations, or edge\-case anomalies, ensuring high data fidelity before sales or proof\-of\-value presentations.
* Produce complete Sales Engineer (SE)\-ready demonstration packages, including runbooks, walkthrough scripts, and technical summaries.



  
 



**6 months:** 



* Autonomously manage end\-to\-end customer proof\-of\-value (POV) tenant builds and complex legacy migration data flows.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Sales Engineering, Product, and Professional Services to resolve customer\-specific identity challenges.
* Contribute enhancements to internal agentic prompts, evaluation benchmarks, and automation scripts (Python/Bash) to boost pipeline accuracy and throughput.
* Diagnose and escalate recurring platform or agent tooling bugs with reproducible test cases and remediation recommendations.



  

**1 year:** 



* Serve as a subject matter expert for agentic operations, driving best practices for prompt engineering and multi\-agent orchestration across the team.
* Architect and deploy new automation tooling, reusable workflows, and evaluation checks that shorten deployment cycles for enterprise migrations.
* Support foundational customer deployments and complex technical escalations alongside the Forward Deployed Engineering organization.
* Attain the SailPoint Certified Engineer or Solution Architect credential.



  
 



**Requirements** 



* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 3–5\+ years of professional work experience within an enterprise software company, systems integrator, or technology consulting firm
* 3\+ years of hands\-on software implementation, technical consulting, or pre\-sales solution engineering experience
* Proven technical proficiency in modern technical infrastructure, including web services, APIs, application servers, databases, and enterprise directories (LDAP/Active Directory)
* Solid understanding of modern SaaS architecture, cloud infrastructure, and core AI/machine learning concepts
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capability, with the ability to isolate root causes from system logs and unformatted customer data
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting technical artifacts to cross\-functional stakeholders
* Ability to travel up to 15% as needed



  
   

  

**Preferred Skills** 



* 3\+ years of specialized experience in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) / IAM solutions
* Hands\-on administrative or development experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) or SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ)
* Experience with competitive IAM platforms (e.g., Saviynt, Oracle Identity Governance, One Identity, RSA/Aveksa) and migration workflows
* Hands\-on familiarity with agentic coding environments and AI developer tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks)
* Practical scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) for API integration, automated testing, and data transformation
* Professional security or industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, J2EE certifications, or SailPoint certifications)



**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**




 Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting\-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever\-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals.
 



 Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2\-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified).

 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. **Company** 
 : AJEMS, Pune

**Type** 
 : Full\-time, onsite
 



  





**About Us** 




 AJEMS is a business operations platform designed to help organizations streamline processes, improve collaboration and gain complete visibility across their operations. AJEMS brings workflows, approvals, data management, and reporting into one place, helping businesses work more efficiently, reduce manual effort, and make informed decisions faster. Built to adapt to the unique needs of every organization, AJEMS empowers teams to digitize operations, enhance accountability, and drive sustainable growth through smarter process management.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




 Own the React architecture for AJEMS (folder structure, state management, routing, component library, build pipeline), carry the same standards into client projects, set coding standards, review all PRs, mentor 4 junior developers daily, break the roadmap into independent tickets, own the Django/DRF backend, set up CI/CD and release process, plan the Angular migration with zero data loss.

 Own the React architecture for AJEMS, including folder structure, state management, routing, component library and build pipeline.
 



 Establish and implement engineering standards across client projects.
 



 Define coding standards and ensure adherence to best practices.
 



 Review pull requests and maintain code quality across projects.
 



 Mentor and guide 4 junior developers on a daily basis.
 



 Break product and development roadmaps into clear, independent and actionable tickets.
 



 Own the Django/DRF backend, including architecture, APIs and database design.
 



 Design and implement scalable and secure backend systems.
 



 Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
 



 Plan and execute the Angular\-to\-React migration with a strong focus on zero data loss and system stability.
 



 Identify and resolve complex technical issues through effective debugging and observability practices.
 



 Establish a strong culture of documentation, testing, security and maintainable code.
 



  





**Must Have Skills and Experience:** 




 Strong experience with React and TypeScript.
 



 Experience building and maintaining large\-scale React applications.
 



 Strong understanding of state management using React Query, Zustand or Redux Toolkit.
 



 Experience with routing, component architecture and scalable frontend structures.
 



 Strong full\-stack development experience with Python/Node.js.
 



 Hands\-on experience with Django/DRF, FastAPI, NestJS or Express.
 



 Strong understanding of asynchronous programming patterns.
 



 Experience designing and developing REST/RPC APIs.
 



 Experience implementing role\-based authentication and authorization.
 



 Strong knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.
 



 Experience designing multi\-tenant data models.
 



 Understanding of safe and reliable database/schema migrations.
 



 Experience working with Redis and caching strategies.
 



 Familiarity with WebSockets and SSE.
 



 Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and release management.
 



 Experience with application debugging and observability.
 



 Strong testing discipline and understanding of automated testing practices.
 



 Good understanding of application security and secure development practices.
 



 Ability to write clear and maintainable technical documentation.
 



 Proven experience mentoring or leading developers.
 



 Ability to review code, provide constructive feedback and maintain engineering standards.
 



 Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
 



 Ability to independently own technical initiatives from planning through deployment.
 



  





**Good To Have :** 




 Experience working on SaaS products.
 



 Knowledge of OAuth and webhooks.
 



 Experience with AWS or GCP.
 



 Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
 



 Understanding of Figma and design systems.
 



 Experience managing client delivery while simultaneously contributing to product development.

 How we work: We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to use and teach the team how to use them without shipping code nobody understands.

**What We’re Looking For**
* Experience: 8\+ years in full\-stack development, including 5\+ years in integration or platform engineering, in a regulated or enterprise environment
* Integrations: Strong experience managing system integrations across enterprise platforms to ensure process efficiency.
* Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using .NET Core, C\#, Azure and modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular).

* DevOps: Experience working with PowerShell, Azure DevOps/Git, Build Management, Continuous Integration (CI), Continuous Delivery (CD).
* Cybersecurity: Ensure application security through secure coding practices, identity management, and compliance with industry standards. Solid understanding of application security principles (OAuth, JWT, encryption, secure coding).
* Operations: Experience in operations support and incident management processes.
* Troubleshooting: Strong coding, debugging, problem\-solving skills and ability to work in agile environments.
* Problem Solver: A strong passion for tackling complex challenges and a keen interest in learning new technologies.
* Leadership: A desire to mentor others and facilitate technical discussions within the team.
* Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Education: Qualifications Required: BE, MSc, MCA, Computer Science or related discipline.


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**
* Flexible Work Environment: Choose between hybrid or in\-office work to suit your lifestyle.
* Annual Learning Budget: Access funds for conferences, courses, or skills development to enhance your professional growth.
* Career Advancement: Clear pathways for career growth and development within the organization.
* Inclusive Culture: Join a collaborative team culture where your ideas are valued, and every voice is heard.


 Ready to make an impact? Apply now and help us shape the future of our data platform!

**The Mindset**

Exercises judgment in selecting methods, evaluating, adapting of complex techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Devises solutions based on limited information and precedent and adapts existing approaches to resolve issues. Uses evaluation, judgment, and interpretation to select the right course of action.
* Adaptability: Eagerness to quickly learn and adopt cutting\-edge technologies. Understands and works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of variable factors.
* Ownership \& Quality: A detail\-oriented mindset with a focus on quality, demonstrating end\-to\-end responsibility for features and architectural components.
* Proactive Leader: Takes initiative to anticipate and address future needs, risks, or improvements.
* Quick Learner: Demonstrates a rapid capacity to grasp new technologies, complex systems, and development methodologies.


**Qualifications \& Next Steps**
* Degree: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience: Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related professional software development experience; or 6 years with a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience.
* Location: This is an on\-site opportunity based in Pune with 3\-4 days work from the office.. Only candidates willing to be based in Pune will be eligible.

* Structured Mentorship: Benefit from a structured program and training designed for rapid career development.1
* Inclusive Culture: Join a collaborative and inclusive environment that champions learning, growth, and diverse perspectives.1
* Ready to step into the future of manufacturing? Apply now and start building a System of Action!

With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
 Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
   

  

 Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
   

  

 Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 This role provides advanced\-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross\-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise\-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front\-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Java Fullstack)
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Gruve is seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Java) for the SecurityHub365 platform to work closely with the Engineering team in Pune and drive backend delivery for Gruve’s multi\-tenant Security Operations (SOC) and ITSM platform. SecurityHub365 ingests and correlates security\-incident data, manages the ITSM lifecycle, and integrates with SIEM/XDR and enterprise systems. It runs as an event\-driven microservice platform and is actively modernising across containerisation, cloud, and stronger platform foundations.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on build\-and\-lead role. The Lead Engineer will own significant parts of the backend, raise the engineering bar, mentor an early\-career team, and drive delivery, while still writing and reviewing code daily. We are an AI\-forward team, and using AI tooling effectively is central to how we build.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Design \& Delivery Ownership**
* Own the end\-to\-end design and delivery of backend services and features, within the platform’s architectural direction, from requirements and API contracts through implementation, testing, and production.
* Make design decisions within your services, set patterns, and guide the team through trade\-offs.
* Contribute to and influence platform architecture alongside the platform architect.


**Technical Leadership \& Mentoring**
* Provide day\-to\-day technical leadership to drive tech deliveries and solutioning and raise the engineering bar through code review and design guidance.
* Mentor junior/new engineers, grow their skills, and reduce single\-points\-of\-failure by spreading knowledge.


**Quality, Security \& Reliability**
* Drive testing strategy, security, resilience, and performance on a multi\-tenant platform where correctness and tenant isolation matter.
* Own non\-functional concerns: authentication and authorization, error handling, observability, and safe rollout.


**AI\-Augmented Engineering (core to this role)**
* Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools (for example Claude Code, Claude, Copilot) day to day: scaffolding, refactoring, generating tests, and documentation.
* Apply strong prompt engineering and agentic, “vibe\-coding” workflows: decompose work into well\-scoped tasks, delegate to AI agents, steer them, and integrate the results cleanly.
* Exercise judgement on where AI helps (boilerplate, CRUD, mirrored patterns, tests, docs) versus where human rigour is required (security, authentication, correctness, and architecture). Review AI\-generated code critically; never merge it blind.
* Help the team adopt AI well, setting sensible practices and review gates so speed never comes at the cost of quality.


**Agile Delivery \& Planning**
* Drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, and breaking epics into deliverable stories.
* Produce defensible estimates grounded in the work, and sequence discovery and scope before committing timelines.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholders**
* Partner with product and the SOC/automation teams to scope work, define boundaries, and turn requirements into buildable plans.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders, manage expectations, and provide clear delivery status.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 to 8 years building systems in Java and React/Angular, min 2 years full stack development exp. with strong fundamentals (OOP, concurrency, data structures, clean code) and depth in Spring Boot.
* Proven experience designing and running microservices and RESTful APIs (contract\-first / OpenAPI a plus).
* Hands\-on with event\-driven architecture using Apache Kafka (topics, consumers, delivery semantics, eventual\-consistency trade\-offs).
* Solid experience with MongoDB (data modelling, queries, indexing); working knowledge of relational databases.
* Experience with authentication and authorization in multi\-tenant systems: JWT/OAuth2 and identity integration (LDAP/AD).
* Experience with containerisation and CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins (or equivalent), Git\-based workflows, static analysis.
* Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring, code review, and owning delivery for a squad.
* Fluency in Agile/Scrum and the ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and defensible estimates.
* Effective, hands\-on use of AI development tools (AI assistants and agentic coding e.g. ClaudeCode) with sound judgement on review and quality.
* Strong communication skills across technical and non\-technical audiences; comfortable working with distributed teams across India and the US.


**Preferred Qualifications/skills**
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Exposure to security operations / SOC / ITSM domains, or integrations with SIEM/XDR (for example QRadar, Cisco XDR), Jira, or Cherwell.
* Experience modernising legacy systems and paying down technical debt.
* Experience mentoring or leading early\-career engineers.
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth technology environment.
* Hands\-on, senior full stack engineer who combines strong system\-design skills with Java \& front end technologies.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

description:
**Position Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced and visionary Java Fullstack Tech Lead (C13 \- Vice President) to lead the design, development, and delivery of mission\-critical, enterprise\-scale applications within Citi. In this role, you will lead high\-performing engineering squads, architect robust microservices and modern UI solutions, drive adoption of cloud\-native and DevOps best practices, and collaborate closely with product management, business stakeholders, and enterprise architecture teams to deliver resilient, high\-throughput financial systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Core Expectations**
* Architectural Design \& Technical Leadership Own end\-to\-end technical solution architecture, translating complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable, fault\-tolerant, and maintainable software designs. Champion modern software paradigms including event\-driven architectures (EDA), domain\-driven design (DDD), asynchronous messaging, and reactive systems. Ensure all technical designs strictly align with Citi’s enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity principles, and non\-functional requirements (NFRs).
* Fullstack Engineering Excellence (Java \& Modern UI) Architect and lead the implementation of resilient backend services using Java 17/21, Spring Boot 3\.x, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, and microservices patterns. Drive modern, modular, accessible, and responsive frontend applications using React, Angular, or TypeScript, enforcing component reusability and high UI performance. Set rigorous engineering standards across the tech stack, ensuring clean code, SOLID principles, optimal algorithm design, and minimal technical debt.
* Cloud\-Native Architecture \& Containerization Drive migration and modernization of services toward cloud platforms (OpenShift / AWS / GCP / Private Cloud / Hybrid). Oversee containerization strategies using Docker and orchestration via Kubernetes / OpenShift (ECS), ensuring auto\-scaling, high availability, and disaster recovery readiness. Architect multi\-region, active\-active, or active\-passive deployment patterns to guarantee business continuity (COB/DR).
* API \& Integration Engineering Design and govern enterprise\-grade RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and gRPC interfaces following OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. Architect asynchronous, event\-driven data streaming pipelines leveraging Apache Kafka, Solace, or IBM MQ. Implement secure API gateway controls, rate\-limiting, mutual TLS (mTLS), token\-based authentication (OAuth2/OIDC), and circuit\-breaking patterns.
* Data Architecture \& Persistence Engineering Lead database design, query optimization, indexing, and data modeling across relational engines (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/Document databases (MongoDB, Cassandra). Implement distributed caching mechanisms using Redis or Hazelcast to optimize response latencies and system throughput. Ensure strict adherence to data governance, lineage, retention, and masking policies for sensitive financial data.
* DevSecOps, CI/CD, \& Quality Engineering Automation Champion automated continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using platforms like Tekton, Jenkins, GitLab/GitHub Actions, and Harness. Enforce automated test\-driven development (TDD), behavior\-driven development (BDD), and integration testing using JUnit 5, Mockito, Cypress, Playwright, or Jest. Mandate static and dynamic security scanning (Snyk, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Black Duck) with zero\-tolerance policies for high\-severity vulnerabilities.
* Observability, Resiliency, \& Site Reliability Implement comprehensive telemetry, metrics, distributed tracing, and centralized logging utilizing OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK/Loki. Drive site reliability engineering (SRE) practices, setting and monitoring Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets. Lead root\-cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, conducting blameless post\-mortems and implementing preventative corrective actions.
* Engineering Governance, Risk, \& Regulatory Compliance Ensure all software deliverables comply with Citi's internal development lifecycle standards, Citi Information Security Policies (CISP), and regulatory compliance guidelines (e.g., SOX, Basel, GDPR). Prepare applications for internal and external audits, architecture review boards (ARB), and threat modeling assessments. Manage risk identification, remediation tracking, and technical mitigation across all owned repositories and systems.
* Team Leadership, Mentorship, \& Talent Development Function as technical mentor and coach for engineers (C09–C12\), conducting rigorous code reviews, pair programming, and technical workshops. Foster a culture of innovation, psychological safety, continuous learning, and engineering excellence across geographically distributed squads. Partner with Engineering Managers on technical hiring, skill assessments, performance reviews, and career development roadmaps.
* Agile Execution \& Stakeholder Collaboration Collaborate actively with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, and Operations teams in PI planning, backlog grooming, and sprint executions. Translate business roadmaps into granular technical user stories, estimation models, and phased release strategies. Communicate technical concepts, project risks, and architectural trade\-offs clearly to senior management and non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Full Stack Lead Engineer
description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

 We want to hire ambitious, and value\-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross\-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high\-growth environment with a fast\-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems across the entire technology stack.
   

  

**About Us**
 At Modulr our mission is to move money efficiently to power business productivity. We are building a new digital payments service to make money flow more efficiently through businesses and the economy. This is a new type of payments account that is built for businesses that need faster, easier and more reliable ways to move money.
   

  

 Our flexible platform and innovative approach allows our customers to utilise our payments account instead of a traditional bank account. Our accounts come with a sort code and account number, access to payment systems (eg Faster Payments and Visa) and everything our customers need from a payments account. They can instantly open as many accounts as they need, automate how they make and receive payments as well as the reconciliation processes these create. All in real time, 24/7 through their own systems utilising our API that integrates into any platform.
   

  

 Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by payments giants PayPal Ventures and FIS Ventures, as well as startup and scale up specialists Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog and Highland Europe which enables us to leverage their resources and expertise to drive our growth initiatives. These partnerships provide us with the necessary provisions to propel our business to new heights.
   

  

**Modulr values**
* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.


**The Role**
 The Full Stack Lead Engineer is a vital role within Modulr, where you will be responsible for building an autonomous, high performing engineering squad to foster an environment where decisions are delegated, made and communicated effectively. You will drive technical strategy with a strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI backend development while remaining deeply hands\-on with core development. The role is a blend of hands\-on Python development, technical leadership, mentoring, and operational excellence. You will lead
   

  

 the architecture and implementation of robust, scalable backend systems using FastAPI, cloud infrastructure on AWS, and coordinate full\-stack solutions with frontend teams.
   

  

**Specific duties**
* Lead a squad of software engineers, driving technical excellence through code reviews, architectural guidance, pair programming, and mentoring with strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI best practices.
* Technically efficient to write production\-quality Python code, designing high\-performance REST APIs, managing databases, async operations, and establishing coding standards.
* Own backend architecture decisions and lead the design of scalable, robust systems using Python, relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), caching layers, and message queues.
* Lead technical strategy for AWS cloud deployments, ensuring security, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Mentor team members to develop deep full stack expertise for both backend \& frontend through 1\-2\-1s, code reviews, and pair programming, fostering their technical growth and career progression.
* Plan squad deliverables and delegate responsibilities clearly, ensuring the team has well\-defined goals, unblocked paths to success, and regular progress tracking.
* Collaborate with Frontend, DevOps, and Product teams to deliver integrated solutions, ensuring seamless API integration between backend and frontend.
* Drive agile practices and conduct productive ceremonies (stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retros), promoting continuous improvement and team autonomy.
* Drive hiring and recruitment, conducting technical interviews, assessments, and candidate evaluations while representing Modulr's engineering culture and values.
* Report on squad progress, outcomes, and technical achievements to leadership; share knowledge and best practices across the broader Engineering organisation.


**About You**
**Must Have** 
 :
   

  

* Expert\-level proficiency in Python (9\+ years), with deep knowledge of Python frameworks, async programming, and backend development best practices.
* Strong, hands\-on experience with FastAPI, including building high\-performance REST APIs, dependency injection, validation, and async operations.
* Solid experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with understanding of full\-stack integration and frontend\-backend communication patterns.
* Hands\-on experience designing, building and deploying systems on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, etc).
* Proven software development and technical team leadership experience, with a strong understanding of backend engineering practices and processes.
* Strong understanding of system design, microservices architecture, database design, and cloud\-native application patterns.
* Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and understanding of data modeling, optimization, and migrations.
* Strong testing discipline (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing) with TDD mindset for backend systems.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical decision\-making in a collaborative environment.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.


**Good to have:**
* Experience with caching solutions (Redis), message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and async task processing.
* Experience in the fintech or payments domain.


**Key Attributes:**
* Strong problem\-solver with deep analytical and critical thinking skills; ability to balance pragmatism with technical excellence.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Self\-directed and proactive, with a drive to continuously learn and innovate in Python and backend technologies.
* Passionate about code quality, performance optimization, and building scalable, maintainable systems.
* Team player with strong collaborative and leadership presence, comfortable guiding the team through technical decisions.


**ModInclusion**
 At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it's also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

* Experience working in AI\-assisted development workflows
* Strong collaboration skills in distributed teams


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* Proven experience working in microservice\-based architectures


**Daily And Monthly Responsibilities**

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Role Title: Full Stack Developer with Agentic AI \& Gen AI** 




**Experience: 4–8 years** 




**Engagement Type: Full\-time** 




**Locations: Noida, Gurgaon, Jaipur, Pune, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad** 




  





 Technology Stack: Backend: Python \+ FastAPI · Frontend: Next.js / React · Cloud \& DevOps: AWS ECS/EC2, Docker, CI/CD, Agentic AI / Gen AI
 



  





 Role Summary
 



 We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer who can own applications end to end — building high\-performance Python/FastAPI backends, developing modern Next.js/React front ends, and taking services all the way to production on AWS through containerised, automated CI/CD pipelines. The ideal candidate is comfortable across the entire stack, from data modelling and API design to responsive UI development and cloud deployment, and thrives in a fast\-paced, quality\-focused delivery environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Design, develop, and maintain full\-stack features spanning the Next.js front end and Python/FastAPI backend.
 



 • Build robust, well\-documented RESTful APIs with FastAPI, including authentication, validation, and error handling.
 



 • Develop responsive, accessible, high\-performance UIs in Next.js/React (SSR/SSG, App Router, state management).
 



 • Build multi\-step agent workflows involving tool/function calling, routing, state management, retries, and human\-in\-the\-loop interactions.
 



 • Integrate LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent platforms.
 



 • Implement RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge retrieval using vector databases/search platforms such as OpenSearch, or similar technologies.
 



 • Model data and design database schemas; write efficient queries and manage migrations.
 



 • Containerise applications with Docker and deploy to AWS ECS (Fargate/EC2\) and EC2\.
 



 • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment.
 



 • Ensure application security, performance, and scalability across the stack.
 



 • Write unit and integration tests; participate in peer code reviews and uphold coding standards.
 



 • Collaborate with product, QA, and infrastructure stakeholders; contribute to estimation and Agile ceremonies.
 



 • Troubleshoot and optimise across the stack — from database queries and API latency to browser rendering and deployment reliability.
 



 Must\-Have Skills
 



 Backend
 



 • Python — advanced proficiency (OOP, typing, async/await).
 



 • FastAPI — production experience building REST APIs; Pydantic models, dependency injection, OpenAPI/Swagger.
 



 • Databases — PostgreSQL/MySQL, ORMs (SQLAlchemy), migrations.
 



 • Auth \& Security — JWT, OAuth2, secure handling of secrets and data.
 



 Frontend
 



 • Next.js / React — production experience with functional components, hooks, SSR/SSG, and the App Router.
 



 • JavaScript / TypeScript — strong command of modern ES features and typed development.
 



 • HTML5 / CSS3 — responsive design and component styling (Tailwind CSS or similar).
 



 Cloud \& DevOps
 



 • AWS — hands\-on with ECS and EC2 deployment; familiarity with S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch.
 



 • Docker — building and optimising container images; registry management (ECR).
 



 • CI/CD — designing and maintaining pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or AWS CodePipeline).
 



 Agentic AI / GenAI
 



 • Experience integrating LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock into applications.
 



 • Understanding of Agentic AI, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi\-step workflows.
 



 • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and knowledge retrieval.
 



 • Familiarity with agent frameworks.
 



 • Experience building AI chat/streaming interfaces using React/Next.js; AG\-UI or similar frameworks is a plus.
 



 General
 



 • Version control — Git\-based workflows (branching, pull requests, code review).
 



 • Testing — PyTest, Jest / React Testing Library.
 



 • Microservices and event\-driven architecture.
 



 Good\-to\-Have Skills
 



 • Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform or CloudFormation).
 



 • Async Python, background processing, and message/task queues (Celery, SQS, Kafka).
 



 • Caching with Redis.
 



 • Kubernetes (EKS) and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).
 



 • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer).
 



 Qualifications
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 



 • Demonstrable track record of shipping and operating full\-stack applications in production.
 



 Key Attributes
 



 • Strong problem\-solving skills and ownership mindset across the full stack.
 



 • Clear communicator, comfortable collaborating across product, engineering, and infrastructure teams.
 



 • Quality\-focused, with attention to security, performance, and maintainability.

title: Application Engineering, Engineer
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are someone who gets energized by the moment when a piece of software you built actually clicks for the person using it. Not when it compiles without errors, but when an engineer on the other side of the world opens your application and their workflow just got easier. You have learned that the hardest part of building useful tools is not the technical implementation, it is understanding what people are actually trying to accomplish.
   

  

 You think in systems, but you communicate in plain language. When a customer describes a problem, you can hold the technical architecture in your head while also tracking what they really need versus what they think they need. You ask clarifying questions that get to the root without making people feel interrogated.
   

  

 You do not wait for perfect information before you start building. You sketch out a solution, validate the approach with the people who will use it, and iterate based on what you learn. When something does not work the way you expected, you dig into why instead of just trying a different approach and hoping it sticks.
   

  

 You care about craft. You write code that someone else can pick up six months from now and understand. You document not because someone told you to, but because you know that good documentation is a gift to your future self and everyone who comes after you.
   

  

 At Synopsys, you will find a place where the applications you build get used by engineers solving real problems.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Design and build full stack web applications using Python, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS that integrate simulation technologies into customer engineering workflows
* Develop backend services and RESTful APIs that connect frontend interfaces to Python\-based automation engines, including PyAnsys libraries where applicable
* Work directly with customers and internal Synopsys teams to translate engineering requirements into working web solutions that fit their actual use cases
* Build, deploy, and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate code generation, improve UI/UX prototyping, debug more effectively, and increase test coverage
* Contribute to code reviews, write clear documentation, and help maintain code quality standards across development projects
* Participate in technical demos and customer presentations to show case solutions, gather feedback, and support adoption of new capabilities


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* You will deliver web applications that make complex simulation workflows accessible and usable for engineers who depend on them to meet project deadlines
* Your backend services and APIs will enable automation that saves customers hours of manual configuration and data handling per project cycle
* The solutions you build will directly influence how customers adopt and scale simulation\-driven design processes across their engineering teams
* Your collaboration with product teams will surface real\-world usage patterns that shape roadmap priorities and improve tool usability based on actual customer needs
* Your containerized deployments and CI/CD pipelines will reduce release cycles and improve reliability for customer\-facing solutions
* You will bridge the gap between advanced simulation technology and practical engineering workflows, making powerful capabilities accessible to users who are not simulation experts
* Your contributions to code quality and documentation will raise development standards for the team and accelerate onboarding for future engineers


 What You'll Need
   

  

* You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with 2\+ years of professional software development experience, or a Master's degree with relevant project or internship experience
* You bring strong proficiency in Python for backend development, including hands\-on experience with Python\-based web or UI frameworks
* You have working knowledge of frontend development concepts and UI/UX principles, with the ability to translate user needs into functional interfaces that people actually want to use
* You are comfortable using Git for version control in a collaborative team environment where multiple people are working in the same codebase
* You have a solid understanding of core backend and infrastructure concepts, including RESTful API design, network fundamentals, and database systems, enabling you to effectively contribute to robust, full\-stack application development.
* You communicate clearly in written and spoken English and can explain technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders without losing the important details
* Experience with the Ansys software ecosystem ,PyAnsys, or similar scientific and engineering application domains is a plus, as is familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can sit with a customer or internal stakeholder, listen to what they are trying to accomplish, and walk away with enough clarity to start building without needing every detail spelled out in advance
* When you review code or see a UI that does not quite work, you speak up with specific suggestions instead of just noting that something feels off, and you do it in a way that helps the team move forward
* You manage multiple threads at once without dropping details, a bug fix, a new feature request, and a deployment can all be in flight and you know exactly where each one stands
* You are comfortable working across time zones and cultures, adjusting your communication style so that nothing gets lost in translation and everyone stays aligned
* You test your own work thoroughly before handing it off because you know that catching issues early saves everyone time downstream and builds trust with the people depending on your code
* You are genuinely curious about how simulation and engineering tools get used in the real world, and that curiosity makes you ask better questions and build better solutions


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Ansys Customer Excellence team, working at the intersection of engineering simulation, modern software platforms, and AI\-enabled solutions. This is a technical role where you will collaborate with customers, internal product teams, and engineers across geographies to shape how simulation technologies are integrated into scalable, cloud\-native platforms. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, current initiatives, and collaboration model during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. * Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)

* Retrieval\-augmented generation or structured retrieval over a large corpus.
* Observability for LLM systems — tracing, token accounting and regression suites for agent behaviour.
* Demonstrated mentoring: pairing, design review and visibly raising the standard of the engineers around you.
* Disciplined use of AI coding assistants within defined engineering and security guardrails: you independently validate generated code, verify it through unit, integration and regression tests, check maintainability, architecture alignment, security, privacy, licensing and performance, and never treat generated output as production\-ready without human review. You can explain and defend any code you submit.
* Comfortable with ambiguity — agent behaviour is established empirically rather than specified up front.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Full stack range — able to build the interfaces that expose agent capability.
* QA or test\-automation domain knowledge.
* Experience with browser automation or DOM analysis libraries. � Cost and performance optimization for LLM workloads.

description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.
