The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading projects, actively contributing to sprint design, and mentoring team members, with a passion for delivering high\-quality, scalable, and efficient software across the full stack.
   

  

**What will you do?**
**Software Development**
 Design, code, and implement full\-stack software solutions using .NET Core (backend/APIs) and TypeScript\-based ReactJS/Next.js (frontend). Develop high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable applications end to end.
   

  

**Technical Design and Architecture**
 Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to define technical vision, system architecture, and integration of AWS services and frontend frameworks. Contribute to the design of software components, ensuring scalability, performance, and adherence to best practices — including serverless\-first patterns where appropriate.
   

  

**AWS Services Integration**
 Utilize AWS services such as DynamoDB, EventBridge, Lambda, S3, and others to design and implement robust, efficient, serverless solutions. Integrate applications with these services, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
   

  

**Frontend Engineering**
 Build responsive, performant, type\-safe user interfaces with TypeScript, React, and Next.js (SSR/SSG, App Router, API routes). Ensure clean integration between frontend applications and .NET Core/serverless backends.
   

  

**Database Integration**
 Design and optimize database schemas and queries for efficient data storage and retrieval in DynamoDB. Integrate and synchronize data across databases and AWS services.
   

  

**Testing and Quality Assurance**
 Write unit and integration tests, conduct code reviews, and enforce coding standards across backend and frontend code. Build and maintain automated test coverage. Collaborate with QA teams to identify and resolve issues.
   

  

**CI/CD and DevOps**
 Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment across environments, supporting serverless deployments (Lambda, S3, CloudFormation/CDK/Serverless Framework).
   

  

**Continuous Improvement**
 Stay current with .NET Core, TypeScript, React/Next.js, AWS, and AI\-assisted development tooling. Identify opportunities for process improvement, code optimization, and enhanced developer workflows — including adopting AI coding assistants to boost team velocity and code quality.
   

  

**Collaboration and Leadership**
 Work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to align development efforts with requirements. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers across both backend and frontend disciplines.
   

  

**Troubleshooting and Support**
 Investigate and resolve complex technical issues in development and production. Support end users/clients to ensure smooth operation of applications.
   

  

**What do you need to know?**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience with .NET Core, with strong AWS\-based project experience.
* Working experience with TypeScript, ReactJS, and Next.js for building production frontend applications.
* Expertise in AWS services, including DynamoDB, EventBridge, and Lambda; solid understanding of S3 and serverless architectures.
* Experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitLab CI.
* Proven track record of leading projects and delivering high\-quality software solutions end to end.
* Deep understanding of software development best practices, coding standards, and design patterns across full\-stack applications.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills across distributed, serverless systems.
* Excellent mentoring and leadership abilities, with a passion for developing junior engineers.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and experience working in an Agile environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.


**Good to have**
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) to accelerate coding, code review, and testing workflows.
* Experience designing and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines for serverless and containerized deployments.
* Experience with Playwright (or similar) for end\-to\-end and browser automation testing.
* AWS certifications, such as AWS Certified Developer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect, are highly desirable.

title: Python Full Stack Tech Lead/Senior Associate Director
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering**
 Global Cybersecurity is responsible for enabling businesses and functions to manage their information, technology and cybersecurity risks by ensuring these are well\-understood, and that controls used the manage such events are defined, assessed and implemented appropriately. Cybersecurity predominantly deliver this via objective, independent, professional and specialized subject matter experts. The role forms part of the first line of defence in relation to the risk management framework.
   

  

 The Cybersecurity Assessment and Testing (CSAT) function, part of Global Cybersecurity, is accountable for Vulnerability Management, Secure Development (inc. DevSecOps), Threat and Controls Assessment (inc. threat modelling) and Third Party Security Assessment. The function drives the identification, capture, assessment, testing/verification and ultimately the remediation of security defects, gaps and vulnerabilities across HSBC’s estate in conjunction with business and technology teams – on\-premise, within the Cloud and for those resulting from third party engagements.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* You’ll lead the technical delivery of full stack services and integrations used by internal cybersecurity stakeholders—covering REST APIs, data pipelines/ETL, CI/CD, and service operability—using HSBC’s CSAT engineering approach: Python\-first, microservice principles, containers, and DevSecOps. You’ll also shape “how we do things” within the team through pragmatic standards, patterns and automation—borrowing the best elements of a principal engineering mindset without being the enterprise\-wide authority.
* The role will partner heavily with cybersecurity experts across CSAT to deliver solutions that help keep the bank secure. Such solutions can include the integration and automation of third\-party scanning tools such that they periodically detect for vulnerabilities across the estate, and report these back to relevant stakeholders. Other solutions can include building in\-house scanning capabilities that look for certain types of security weaknesses.
* As a Senior Tech Lead, your responsibilities will include the following: Technical delivery \& team leadership\- Lead technical design and delivery for a pod/squad in an agile/DevSecOps environment, partnering closely with the Product Owners and Global Head of Engineering.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction: break down work, define technical approaches, unblock engineers, and ensure quality outcomes. Remain hands\-on in development (expected to contribute code regularly) across backend, pipelines and automation.
* Solution design (secure\-by\-design): Design and evolve loosely coupled microservices and internal platforms supporting cyber use\-cases such as: automation/integration of third\-party scanning tools, in\-house scanning capabilities, workflow and reporting services for vulnerability management and assurance, Apply and coach modern patterns aligned to the existing stack, including microservices and event based systems where appropriate.
* DevSecOps, reliability \& automation : Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub) to reduce friction and increase reliability. Drive a strong operability culture: L2/L3 troubleshooting, incident hygiene, release discipline, technical documentation, and measurable service health. Drive the remediation of problem actions following incidents. Drive the team to deliver high quality observability in everything they build, from the very beginning.
* AI solutions \& AI\-assisted engineering: Build AI\-enabled features/services (e.g., triage, classification, summarisation, anomaly detection, prioritisation) where they measurably improve cyber outcomes. Champion responsible use of AI coding tools (e.g., pair\-programming assistants) with guardrails: secure coding, data handling, code review expectations, and testing standards. Introduce repeatable team practices to accelerate delivery with AI (prompt patterns, evaluation approaches, secure usage guidance, and CI checks).
* Engineering excellence (team\-level) : Establish pragmatic standards and patterns for your squad: code quality, testing, branching strategy, service templates, reusable libraries.Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews and peer reviews; lead by example.


**To be successful , you need to have**
* Strong, proven experience delivering production services in Python, with modern web frameworks (FastAPI preferred, Flask/Django also relevant). Demonstrable experience designing and delivering REST API services, integrations to third\-party products, and internal end\-user services.
* Solid experience with microservice architecture and practical application of distributed systems patterns. Strong hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes deployments. Strong CI/CD engineering experience (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab) including automated tests and release pipelines.
* Strong Linux administration and core networking knowledge. Proficiency with Git and branching strategies (e.g., GitFlow or trunk\-based). Strong SQL skills (complex queries). Confidence leading technical delivery: making design decisions, guiding others, and raising engineering standards through reviews and mentoring.
* Experience building AI\-enabled software (e.g., using ML/NLP services, LLM\-based components, or applied AI workflows) and using AI coding tools in a professional engineering environment with quality controls.
* Working style \& behaviours : Clear communicator who can translate between engineers and non\-engineers in a global team. Comfortable moving at pace while operating safely in a highly regulated environment. Inclusive leader who supports different perspectives and helps the team succeed together.
* Great to have (i.e. what would really help you standout): Cybersecurity engineering experience (e.g., SAST/DAST integration, pen testing concepts, fuzzing, threat detection/exploitation techniques).
* Cloud platform delivery experience (AWS/Azure/GCP), Terraform, and operational monitoring (e.g., Prometheus) and/or service mesh. Strong front\-end experience (e.g., React) beyond baseline HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
* Experience with relational and non\-relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MSSQL, MongoDB) including performance tuning. Experience with message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ).


 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI\-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership\-based and service\-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**About the opportunity**




 Join our
 *Embedded Payments team* 
 as
 *Sr. Fullstack Software Engineer* 
 in
 *Pune, India* 
 to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every code line we write and every interface we design is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve.
   

  





 Reporting into
 *the Director of Software Engineering* 
 , you'll take ownership of complex, cross\-cutting problems across our cloud\-native payment orchestration platform that processes significant transaction volume across multiple Xplor brands — from API contract through data model to UI. You'll be a technical anchor for your area: setting direction on design, raising the bar on code quality and testing, and mentoring mid\-level engineers as the team scales. You're comfortable owning ambiguous problems end\-to\-end and collaborating closely with Product, QA, and DevOps to make sound trade\-offs between speed and long\-term platform health.
   

  





 We're looking for someone who treats AI tooling as a force multiplier. You should be fluent with modern AI\-assisted development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) and have a point of view on how to use them well — where they accelerate work, where they need guardrails, and how to keep quality high as velocity increases.
   

  

  

  





**Our Tech Stack**



* **Frontend:** 
 React (CRA), Material\-UI, JavaScript
* **Testing:** 
 Jest, ESLint, Prettier, Storybook, Playwright. K6
* **Backend:** 
 Node.js, AWS (ECS, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, Lambda, Cognito, SQS, EventBridge)
* **DevOps:** 
 Bitbucket Pipelines, Terraform
* **Payments:** 
 Worldpay, Stripe, Apple Pay / Google Pay



**Responsibilities \& Duties**



* Lead the design and delivery of complex, cross\-cutting features spanning APIs, data models, and UI, with a strong eye toward scalability, reliability, and maintainability
* Drive technical design for new payments capabilities, including architecture trade\-offs, operational feasibility, and risk assessment
* Set the technical direction for your area of the platform and ensure consistency with broader architectural patterns
* Mentor mid\-level engineers through code review, design discussions, and pairing; raise the overall engineering bar on the team
* Identify and resolve systemic issues — performance bottlenecks, reliability gaps, technical debt — before they become customer\-facing problems
* Partner with QA to define verification strategy and ensure new features are well\-instrumented and observable in production
* Lead or significantly contribute to incident response and root\-cause analysis for production payments issues; participate in on\-call rotation
* Contribute to roadmap and estimation discussions, providing senior technical judgment on scope and sequencing
* Use AI\-assisted development tools effectively and help establish team norms for using them responsibly at scale
* Stay current with platform updates, security practices, and PCI compliance requirements, and help uplift the team's practices accordingly


**Qualifications**

**What would make me a good candidate?**




 We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever\-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big\-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.
   

  





**You'll need:**



* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a Computer Science/Engineering degree or equivalent
* Deep Node.js experience and a track record of designing and shipping production backend services at scale
* Experience building React\-based frontends that consume RESTful APIs
* Demonstrated ownership across the full stack — you can independently scope, design, and deliver a feature from data model to UI
* Proven experience designing RESTful APIs and service\-oriented or microservice architectures, including making and defending architectural trade\-offs
* Strong working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), data modeling, and service boundary design
* Substantial hands\-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform in a production environment
* Experience owning CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar), including release and rollback strategy
* Proficiency with Git, agile delivery, and testing frameworks like Jest
* Experience mentoring other engineers and influencing technical direction beyond your own individual contributions
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and an articulate point of view on where they help and where they don't
* Comfortable working on a 100% remote team and able to operate independently while providing technical leadership within an agile group



**It would be great if you also have:**



* Experience building or operating payments systems — payment orchestration, tokenization, acquirer integrations (Worldpay, Stripe, Adyen, Finix, Basis Theory), or PCI\-compliant environments
* Familiarity with event\-driven architectures (SQS, EventBridge, Kafka)
* Exposure to observability tooling (SigNoz, Grafana, Datadog, etc.)
* Infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Terraform)



*At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences \- people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.*



**Additional Information**

**Values and Life at Xplor**




 Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:
   

  




* Find a better way
* Do the right thing
* Say it straight
* Win together
* Own the outcome



 If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.
   

  





 As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.
   

  





**Some of our perks and benefits are:**



* Paid Parental Leave benefit programs
* \#GiveBackDays/Commitment to social impact – 3 extra days off to volunteer and give back to your local community
* Ongoing dedication to Diversity \& Inclusion initiatives such as D\&I Council, Global Mentorship Program
* Access to free mental health support
* Flexible working arrangements



**Ready to apply?**




 To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Please include the word "moonshot" at the top of your message to the Hiring Manager so that we know you took the time to read our job ad.
   

  





 We kindly ask you to apply through our careers portal or external job boards (LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, etc)
 
 only
 
 .
 **Please don't send your application via email.** 
 They will not be forwarded.
   

  





**More about us** 
  

  





 More than 130,000 businesses in 72\+ countries rely on Xplor to run their day and get paid, processing over $47 billion in payments annually. Our connected ecosystem helps operators spend less time managing complexity and more time delivering the experiences that matter most.
   

  





 Xplor is backed by world\-class investors Advent International, Battery Ventures, and Silver Lake.
   

  





**Good to know**




 To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorised to work in the location (country) you're applying for. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time.
   

  





 To learn more about us and our products, please visit xplor.com/careers/.
   

  





 We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process xplor.com/recruitment\-faqs/.
   

  





**EEO and Artificial Intelligence**




 We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system that includes artificial intelligence enabled features to assist with the screening and assessment of job applications, such as candidate scoring or ranking. These tools support our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team following human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.
   

  





 Xplor is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We provide equal opportunities to all our employees and to all eligible applicants for employment in our company. We do not unfairly discriminate on any ground, including race, religion, color, ancestry, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, disability or any other category protected by applicable law.
   

  





**We make it a priority to respond to every applicant.**

title: Cloud Solution Delivery Lead Consultant
description:
**India T\&M Special Bonus:**
**Req ID:** 
 390443
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Cloud Solution Delivery Lead Consultant to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN\-MH), India (IN).
   

  

**NTT DATA Job Description**
**IDP Platform Engineer**
**Practice**
 Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platform team
   

  

**Location**
 India, offshore delivery centre
   

  

**Start dates**
 November 2026 (x2\); January 2027 (x3\)
   

  

**Positions**
 Grade 10\-11
   

  

**Reports to**
 IDP Technical PM
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Integration development: Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* Catalogue data: Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* Workflow orchestration: Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* Pipeline products: Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* Developer enablement: Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* Integration runtime: Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* Performance testing capability: Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* Quality gates: Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.


**Essential**
* CI/CD depth: 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* Kubernetes: Solid working Kubernetes
* Scripting and APIs: Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* Software engineering: Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* API integration: Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* Enablement mindset: A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* Pipeline security: Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* Test automation in CI: integrate automated testing into pipelines


**Nice to Have**
* Durable orchestration: Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* IaC: Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* Performance testing: k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* Ecosystem: Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* Security: Container and Kubernetes security.


**Technologies \& Tools**
 The platform environment:
   

  

* Developer portal: Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* Languages: TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* Orchestration: GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* Delivery toolchain: GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* Integrations: ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.


**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.
   

  

 Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
   

  

***NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.***

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you'd like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here. For Pay Transparency information, please click here.***

 We are currently looking for a ‘Lead Software Engineer’ for Payment Reconciliation Intelligence Program, within B\&MI group, to design scalable architecture and lead development of the new business requirements for product used by global B2B customers.

 \-All About You\-
   

  

 Education and professional experience
   

  

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
   

  

 Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple organizational levels.
   

  

 Around 9 years of work experience in the software engineering role.
   

  

 Technical Expertise
   

  

 Strong proficiency in Java 17\+, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Hibernate, and modern database technologies including Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch.
   

  

 Proven experience designing, developing, and leading applications built on microservices\-based architectures.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with messaging and event\-driven platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, or other cloud\-native messaging solutions.
   

  

 Front\-end development experience using React JS (16\+) or Angular (14\+).
   

  

 Experience designing and developing APIs using OpenAPI specifications and RESTful best practices.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, Node.js, UNIX shell scripting, Python, and Groovy scripting.
   

  

 Understanding of modern application security, scalability, resiliency, and performance engineering practices.
   

  

 Tools \& Methodologies
   

  

 Proficiency with build and dependency management tools such as Maven and Gradle.
   

  

 Experience with automation and configuration management tools including Chef and Ansible.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Jenkins, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile software development methodologies.
   

  

 Strong understanding of release management practices including Canary, Blue\-Green, and Rolling deployments.
   

  

 Infrastructure \& Cloud
   

  

 Extensive experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud\-native application development.
   

  

 Strong expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
   

  

 Deep understanding of DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, deployment strategies, and operational excellence in cloud environments.
   

  

 Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK Stack, and related logging platforms.
   

  

 AI \& Emerging Technologies
   

  

 Exposure to Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based solutions, including integrating AI services through APIs and leveraging AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and enterprise AI platforms.
   

  

 Familiarity with AI\-driven application patterns such as Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent workflows, agentic solutions, and prompt engineering concepts for enterprise applications.

 Knowledge of OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing concepts.
   

  

 Familiarity with business rules engines such as Drools and EasyRules.
   

  

 Strong understanding of cryptographic concepts including PKI infrastructure, hashing, encryption, consensus algorithms, and virtual machine architectures.
   

  

 Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and infrastructure automation frameworks.

 to build and evolve the analytics and data applications that serve our customers and internal teams — and to lead the modernisation of the legacy Java/Spring Batch ingestion layer that currently underpins them.
   

  

 This is a highly hands\-on role with breadth across backend (Java/Spring, Python), frontend
   

  

 (TypeScript/React), cloud (GCP, Cloud Run, GKE), and data. You will own features end\-to\-end: from design through implementation, deployment, and production operation.
   

  

 The Spring Batch modernisation is the most technically substantive challenge in this role. You will be inheriting legacy ingestion services that need to be redesigned, migrated to cloud\-native GCP architecture, and retired cleanly — without disrupting the analytics applications that depend on them.
   

  

 That's the real work
   

  

**Time allocation (approximate):**
 \~40% analytics application development (frontend \+ backend) \| \~30% Spring Batch modernisation and cloud\-native migration \| \~15% platform reliability and operations \| \~15% architecture, documentation, and mentoring
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Analytics \& Data Applications**
* Design, build, and operate enterprise analytics portals that integrate with modern visualization and reporting platforms
* Build self\-service data access applications for internal and external customers
* Develop administration portals for data onboarding, configuration management, and platform administration
* Implement secure, scalable, and maintainable application components for a global customer base
* Build and maintain APIs consumed by analytics applications, administration tools, and third\-party integrations


**Platform Modernisation**
* Maintain, enhance, and progressively retire legacy Spring Batch and Java\-based ingestion solutions
* Design and implement modern cloud\-native replacements using GCP services (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GKE) where appropriate
* Reduce technical debt systematically — not just keep it at bay
* Improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency as part of modernisation work
* Contribute to architecture decisions on the migration target state


**Full Stack Engineering**
* Develop modern web applications using TypeScript and React — from component design to production deployment
* Build backend services, REST APIs, and integrations in Java (Spring Boot/Spring Batch) and Python
* Implement event\-driven integrations where the architecture requires it
* Build reusable libraries, components, and tooling that improve productivity across the team


**Software Engineering Excellence**
* Apply test\-driven development, code reviews, CI/CD, and automated testing as default practice
* Produce high\-quality, maintainable, and well\-documented software
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to component\-level design decisions
* Continuously improve engineering standards and code quality across the team


**AI\-Assisted Engineering**
* Use AI\-assisted development tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, or equivalent agentic coding platforms) to accelerate implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation
* Maintain full engineering accountability for delivered software — AI tooling accelerates your work; it doesn't replace your judgment


 What you need to fulfill the role
   

  

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* You are a strong full stack engineer with Java/Spring depth on the backend and TypeScript/React on the frontend — and you have worked in cloud\-native environments on GCP. Specifically:
* 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong Java proficiency — Spring Boot and Spring Batch in production; you can read, debug, and extend Spring Batch jobs under real production pressure
* Strong Python proficiency — backend services, data pipelines, scripting
* Strong TypeScript and React proficiency — building production\-grade web applications, not component libraries in isolation
* Strong REST API design and implementation experience
* Strong GCP experience — Cloud Run and GKE in particular; you have deployed and operated services on these platforms
* Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, microservices architecture, and API design principles
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices TDD, automated unit and integration tests, and code review as standard practice
* Experience troubleshooting production systems and leading root cause analysis


**Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Skills)**
* Event\-driven architecture experience (Pub/Sub, Kafka, Cloud Storage triggers)
* Redux or modern state management framework experience
* GraphQL experience
* Next.js experience
* Data warehousing concepts and data modelling (BigQuery, Snowflake)
* Experience building internal enterprise platforms or administration portals
* Experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring junior engineers
* Experience working in globally distributed engineering organisations


**Soft Skills**
* Ownership mindset — you drive work to completion without being managed
* Comfortable with technical ambiguity — the Spring Batch modernisation does not have a finished design; you will help define it
* Strong communicator across technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Mentors naturally — you invest in the growth of engineers around you
* Balances delivery speed with software quality — you know when to move fast and when to slow down


**What Success Looks Like**
**In 30 days**
* Fully onboarded on the analytics application stack, Spring Batch ingestion layer, and GCP infrastructure
* First frontend or backend contribution shipped to production
* Spring Batch modernisation scope and target architecture understood


**In 90 days**
* Own at least one analytics portal feature end\-to\-end — from design through production deployment
* First Spring Batch modernisation milestone delivered: one legacy service migrated or retired
* Contributing to architecture decisions on the migration target


**In 6 months**
* Major analytics portal capability delivered and in production
* Meaningful reduction in Spring Batch legacy footprint
* Observability and reliability improvements shipped across at least one component


**In 12 months**
* Multiple analytics portal capabilities delivered with full engineering ownership
* Spring Batch modernisation significantly advanced — legacy footprint materially reduced
* Junior engineers mentored and growing; engineering practices stronger across the team


**The 3 Must\-Haves**
* Java \+ Spring Boot/Spring Batch production depth — you can maintain, extend, and migrate real Spring Batch jobs; this is not negotiable and cannot be learned on the job here
* TypeScript \+ React in production — not side projects; shipped, maintained applications that real users depend on
* GCP cloud\-native deployment experience — Cloud Run and/or GKE in production; you


 understand how cloud\-native services behave under load and failure
   

  

**You might be a fit if**
* You have maintained a legacy Java codebase and understand the difference between refactoring it carefully and breaking it
* You enjoy owning both the frontend and the API layer — you don't wait for a backend engineer to build what you need
* You find the Spring Batch → cloud\-native migration problem interesting rather than daunting
* You have strong opinions about API design and can explain them clearly


**You're probably NOT a fit if**
* Your Java experience is primarily greenfield microservices — Spring Batch specifically requires different experience
* Your frontend work has been UI components and design systems, not complete web applications with API integration
* You prefer deep specialisation in one layer over breadth across the stack
* You need a stable, well\-defined architecture to work within — the modernisation path is still being shaped


 What we offer
   

  

**GCP certification sponsorship \| Hybrid working \| Work from abroad \| Flexible working hours \| Udemy Access \| Thinkproject Academy \| Free English lessons \| Unlimited learning \| Headspace community access \| Women's Network \| Corporate volunteering \| Social events \| Open forum with the Leadership Team (TP Café)**
 If you join us in Pune, you will own meaningful work across the full stack — not be a specialist locked into one layer. The Spring Batch modernisation is real technical debt that needs a real engineer, not a workaround.
   

  

**Your Contact**
 Preethika Ramdass
   

  

 Please submit your application, including salary expectations and potential date of entry, by submitting the form on the next page.
   

  

* Submit your CV and a short written answer (max 250 words) to: "You are inheriting a Spring Batch job that runs nightly, processes 500k records, and has no tests. The team wants to migrate it to a cloud\-native GCP solution. Walk me through your first two weeks."

 performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,
 



 designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.
 



  





**About The Role** 




 As a Principal Software Engineer at Rosterfy, you are the most senior individual contributor in the engineering team, responsible for setting technical direction while staying deeply hands\-on. You work across our two product squads as a force multiplier: designing architecture, pairing on hard problems, and unblocking delivery on critical initiatives. Reporting to the HoE, you connect product strategy to implementation detail, ensuring the client's v3 (event\-driven, domain\-driven, AI\-augmented) is robust, scalable, and maintainable across our PHP/Laravel backend, Next.js frontend, and AWS/GCP infrastructure. You spend a significant portion of your time building (coding, reviewing, debugging, pairing) while also shaping engineering standards, architecture, and long\-term platform evolution. You do not manage people directly; instead, you lead through technical excellence, influence, and mentoring.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own the architecture and technical direction for core platform domains used by both squads (e.g. event\-driven workflows, modular boundaries, AI capabilities).

* Lead the technical discovery and delivery of high\-impact initiatives, especially those that cross team boundaries or require significant architectural change.
* Define, document, and evangelize architectural principles, coding standards, and patterns for scalable, resilient, observable systems.
* Raise the bar for quality: champion shift\-left testing, CI/CD improvements, and production observability; model best practices in test design and validation.
* Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers through design reviews, pairing, and feedback, helping them own systems end\-to\-end rather than taking work away.
* Evaluate and prototype emerging technologies (e.g. Vertex AI, GenAI workflows, data pipelines) and guide pragmatic adoption into product and platform.
* Act as a senior engineering voice in roadmap planning, estimation and trade\-off decisions, ensuring technical health is represented alongside product goals
* Works across both product squads rather than being embedded in one team, focusing on cross\-cutting systems and the hardest technical problems.
* Partners with the Engineering Leadership on long\-term architecture and with Tech Leads on execution and engineering practices.



**Technical** 



* 8\+ years in software engineering, including experience as a staff/principal engineer or architect in a SaaS company
* Deep expertise in backend engineering with Laravel (Laravel 10\+ and PHP 8\+) or similar languages, SQL/relational databases, caching, and RESTful APIs
* Strong frontend design and architectural experience with React/
 
 Next.js
* Experience working with scalable, secure cloud infrastructure (AWS required, \& CGP)
* Familiarity with event\-driven or modular architectures and containerized environments (e.g., EKS/Kubernetes)
* Deep understanding of software testing strategies and CI/CD pipelines
* Bonus: experience with Looker, BigQuery, ML pipelines, or distributed system performance tuning
* Bonus: Agent AI Architecture



**AI Driven Skills** 



* Feature delivery velocity (Copilot, Gemini, test automation, scaffolding)
* Building AI\-augmented product experiences (LLM API usage, prompt design)
* Coaching others on integrating GenAI into workflows



**Character \& Mindset** 



* Resilient and adaptable \- You embrace change and help others navigate ambiguity with calm and confidence.
* Proactive problem solver \- You identify issues early, take ownership, and push solutions forward without waiting to be asked.
* Clear communicator \- You articulate ideas clearly, write well, and listen with intent. You create shared understanding.
* Product\-minded \- You're curious about customer needs, ask "why?", and advocate for solutions that deliver real value.
* Leads through influence \- You raise the bar by mentoring others, setting standards, and sharing knowledge — not by authority.
* Documentation\-first thinker \- You value written clarity, and help your team by documenting decisions, code, and processes.



**Shift\-Left QA Expectation** 



* Lead by example in test strategy and validation
* Own test coverage, pipeline health, and regression control



**Success Measures** 



* Enables long\-term scalability and stability through architectural design
* Mentors and unblocks engineers across teams, raising overall technical quality
* Drives alignment on technical priorities and engineering direction
* Trusted advisor to Product sharing functional knowledge
* Proactively identifies and resolves system\-level challenges
* Supports successful implementation of new platform capabilities (e.g., AI readiness, multi\-cloud architecture)



**Nice to have:** 



* Experience with data products like Looker, BigQuery, or analytics pipelines
* Exposure to event\-driven systems, asynchronous workflows, or message
* queues (e.g. AWS SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub)
* Experience with design systems \| frontend architecture
* Passionate about product quality and customer experience
* Experience with platform engineering or building shared infrastructure in modular monoliths
* Any exposure to AI driven tooling, systems



  





**Benefits** 



* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no\-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits

* Gratuity

 Senior Full Stack Developer
 



**Experience:** 
 5\+ years
 



**Locations** 
 \- Bangalore / Hyderabad / Indore / Noida / Pune / Gurgaon / Chennai
 



 Experience: 5–8 years
 



  





**About the Role\-** 




 We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer with strong hands\-on expertise in Python and React to build and evolve reliable, secure, and scalable applications end\-to\-end.
 



 In this role, you’ll work across our Python backend, PostgreSQL database, and React frontend, taking ownership of features from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. You’ll be expected to make sound architectural decisions while remaining highly hands\-on in the codebase.
 



 This role is a great fit for an engineer who combines strong full\-stack fundamentals with a pragmatic approach to AI\-assisted software development. You should be comfortable incorporating AI coding assistants and agentic development tools into your daily workflow while recognizing when complex, security\-sensitive, or business\-critical logic requires careful human design, implementation, and validation.
 



 Because our platform processes sensitive healthcare and financial information, security, auditability, data integrity, and access control are fundamental to how we build software.

* 5–8 years of professional full\-stack software development experience, with strong hands\-on depth across both frontend and backend engineering.
* Strong production experience with Python, building robust APIs, backend services, business logic, and integrations.
* Strong expertise in React, with experience building maintainable, performant, and scalable frontend applications.

* Experience working with sensitive, regulated, or confidential data, ideally in environments involving HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or similar compliance standards.
* A strong engineering mindset around security, auditability, access controls, data privacy, data integrity, and deterministic system behavior.
* Ability to work effectively as a senior individual contributor, providing technical leadership through execution and judgment without needing to be the most senior person in the room.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to balance engineering quality, product requirements, delivery timelines, and long\-term maintainability.
* Past work experience in over\-lapping shifts.



  





**Nice to Have\-** 



* Experience in healthcare technology or fintech.
* Experience building systems where software\-generated recommendations or decisions can have a meaningful impact on healthcare costs or financial outcomes.
* Familiarity with designing systems for highly regulated or security\-sensitive environments.
* Experience establishing or improving engineering practices around AI\-assisted development, code review, testing, and developer productivity.

* Remediation Workflow: A tracking and resolution tool designed to efficiently manage non\-compliant funds.


 Our partner (and launch client) manages over 10,000 funds. As a result, you will operate in an environment where handling ultra\-high data volumes and ensuring system resilience are critical priorities—making for exciting daily challenges.
   

  

**Role Description \& Responsibilities**
* Technical Leadership \& Architecture Collaboration
* Technical Excellence: Champion engineering best practices, modern design patterns, and high code quality standards across the software lifecycle to deliver robust \& scalable solutions.
* Architecture \& Design: Collaborate with Software Architects to design and implement modular, scalable, and resilient software components capable of processing high volume, business critical data ensuring performance \& reliability.
* Enterprise Feature Development: Lead the hands\-on development of complex, high\-impact business\-critical features that span across products, services and engineering teams.
* Domain Delivery \& Regulatory Compliance
* Financial Domain Expertise: Translate complex financial, regulatory, and business rules into robust, high performance software solutions.
* Security \& Compliance: Ensure all applications strictly adhere to strict banking security, privacy, and regulatory standards.

* Empower Engineering Teams: Support squad leads and development teams by unblocking technical challenges and elevating overall team delivery capabilities.

* Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering
* 13\+ years of experience in software development
* Strong experience in product developement is mandatory (preferrably recent experience)
* Strong experience in .Net 8/10 programming language
* Proficient in Hangfire
* Proficient in Entity Framework / nHibernate
* Strong experience in relational databases (PostgreSQL)

* Thrive in a collaborative, innovative, and engineering\-driven culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing.

title: Lead, SW Engineer, Private Capital Technology

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**
 Lead, SW Engineer, Private Capital Technology is responsible for developing and maintaining Private Capital specific programs and processes. Primary system is Private Capital Suite (fka Investran) and all the development tools associated with it. Design, develop, troubleshoot and improve change resilient application code and execute robust effective testing. Manage task and project execution to ensure expected business requirements and related benefits are delivered within appropriate time/budget parameters. Flexibly work independently and as part of a team toward individual and team projects. From a product mindset perspective, engage in supporting applications (L2/L3\). Comply with Technology mandates as they relate to methodology, process, and compliance. Candidate will need to work afternoon shifts to support EMEA business users, including some weekend work when deploying code.
   

  

**Experience/Skills**
 Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Primary experience in dotnet and SQL stored procedures.
* Experience with project feasibility, definition requirements, design, testing and project delivery
* Experience with Agile project methodologies, CICD workflows, vulnerability management and issue remediation


**Required Skills**
* SQL
* dotnet
* REST APIs
* Terraform and IAAS
* Experience on working on Azure Cloud
* Proven problem solving and organizational skills
* Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Work in a manner in keeping with the Northern Trust company’s core values
* Fast learner
* Self\-motivated


**Preferred/ Recommended Skills**
* Experience in Private Capital and/or Financial industry
* PCS Live (fka Investran) experience
* Python
* Kafka
* Active Templates, Allocation Rules and Business Events
* ACCEL workflows


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees.  Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Tech Lead – Production Support & Application Development
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
   

  

 Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
   

  

 Technical Lead – Production Support \& Application Development
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on technical professional with 5\+ years of experience in production support and application development for enterprise applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be able to troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, contribute to application enhancements, and work closely with development, QA, support, product, and business teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud platforms.
* Perform root cause analysis and contribute to permanent fixes to reduce recurring incidents.
* Develop, enhance, test, and maintain enterprise application features, services, and integrations.
* Analyze logs, monitoring alerts, database issues, and system behavior to identify and resolve defects.
* Support deployment, release validation, post\-release checks, and operational stability activities.
* Collaborate with development, QA, support, product, and business teams to ensure timely issue resolution and smooth delivery.
* Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and knowledge articles.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in software development, production support, application support, or production engineering.
* Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and backend application development.
* Good understanding of SQL, relational databases, query troubleshooting, and data validation.
* Working knowledge of frontend technologies such as Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and JSON.
* Experience troubleshooting application, API, database, integration, and infrastructure\-related issues.
* Exposure to Git, CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, Agile/DevOps practices, and release support.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS and basic understanding of containers or cloud\-hosted applications.


 Good\-to\-have Skills
   

  

* Experience with Salesforce integrations, CRM platforms, licensing, entitlement, order management, subscription, or customer\-facing business applications.
* Knowledge of GraphQL, microservices, messaging platforms, API management, Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service.
* Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Application Insights, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, or similar platforms.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

 The candidate should be a practical, hands\-on engineer with strong debugging skills, an ownership mindset, and the ability to balance production stability with development delivery. They should communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and be willing to learn new tools, technologies, and business processes.
   

  

 Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.
   

  

 If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?
   

  

 We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

title: IT Application Services Specialist
description:
**About Toll Group**
 At Toll, we do more than just logistics \- we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small. We have been supporting our customers for more than 130 years. Today, we support more than 20,000 customers worldwide with 500 sites in 27 markets, and a forwarding network spanning 150 countries. We are proudly part of Japan Post — www.tollgroup.com
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Execute tasks leveraging domain expertise in ServiceNow development, with a focus on ITSM and ITOM modules.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of organizational processes and platform capabilities.
* Analyze and resolve a range of moderately complex issues using established policies, ITIL best practices, and platform governance standards.
* Operate with moderate supervision, following structured procedures and development guidelines.
* Perform a variety of routine and semi\-complex assignments across ServiceNow modules including ITSM, ITOM, SAM, HAM, HRSD, GBS and Employee Center.
* Support onboarding and mentoring of new team members.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**What You’ll Need**
* 7\-12 years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow development and platform configuration.
* Proven experience in implementing and supporting ServiceNow ITSM and ITOM modules, including Discovery, CMDB, Event Management, and Service Mapping.
* Proficiency in designing and maintaining integrations using REST, SOAP, and other web technologies (HTTP, AJAX, XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
* Strong programming skills in at least one modern language (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C\+\+).
* Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as AngularJS, Node.js, jQuery, Apache Jelly, or React.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and algorithms.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Experience in developing and deploying ServiceNow applications and modules including Employee Center, SAM, HAM, HRSD, and ITSM.
* Create and implement Business rules, UI Actions, UI Policies, and Client Scripts for various applications in ServiceNow.
* Develop strategies for identifying issues and gaps for various modules in ITSM and ITOM areas.
* Experienced in various phases of Event Management which includes configuring Event Mapping Rules, Event Transform Rules, and Alert Rules.
* Experienced in customizing Email Notifications, Inbound Email Actions, Reports, and Dashboards.
* Implemented integrations between ServiceNow and third\-party applications using REST and SOAP APIs. Experienced in creating homepages and dashboards for stakeholders.
* Ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code; debug and optimize for performance and scalability.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Working knowledge of ITIL framework and its application within ServiceNow.


**Desirable Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* ServiceNow Certifications (at least two of the following preferred):
+ Certified System Administrator
+ Certified Application Developer
+ Certified Implementation Specialist (SAM, HAM, HRSD, or ITSM)

* Experience with enterprise systems such as Workday, SAP, or Microsoft Entra.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and service management principles.


**Why Join Us?**
 At Toll Group, we are committed to transforming enterprise operations through technology. You’ll be part of a team driving automation, improving onboarding processes, and enhancing regulatory compliance through ServiceNow. This is a unique opportunity to grow your skills in a supportive environment while contributing to impactful projects.
   

  

**What moves you?**
 At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000\+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry\-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.
   

  

 Are you excited about this role but are concerned you don’t meet all the requirements? If you have similar skills and are willing to learn then we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that some people hesitate to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly then please talk to us – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up.
   

  

 At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.
   

  

 To find out more about us visit www.careers.tollgroup.com

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are currently seeking a software engineering manager to join the Alternatives Data Management (ADM) team. Our team is building AI\-powered data products and workflow solutions that unlock transparency, efficiency, and insight in private market investments. You’ll lead a full\-stack team of engineers and collaborate closely with Product and Design to deliver client\-facing features that will set us apart from our competitors.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Manage a small team of frontend and backend engineers that will grow as you do
* Own technical design and implementation for some of your projects to set a good example for the ICs
* Work with platform teams to deliver features with consistent capabilities
* Drive the career growth of your direct reports
* Stay up to date on industry trends, such as AI tooling, that can make the team more effective
* Collaborate with ADM engineering and product leads in the US, UK and India to drive team\-wide process improvements and best practices


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* Minimum 10\+ years of software engineering experience
* Minimum 2\+ years managing software engineering teams
* Full\-stack, product engineering experience a big plus
* React experience a plus
* Strong experience with Python OR Java will be required
* Experience with AWS will be highly preferred


***Important Note: This role requires working from our Pune office 3 days a week (hybrid work model)***
**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta\-operations@addepar.com.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Workday Technical Consultant
description:
* 2\+ years of experience in leading the design, development and implementation of Workday HCM(Technical/Functional)
* Design and develop Workday Integrations and reporting solutions to meet business requirements
* Configure and maintain Workday Integrations, EIB, CC, Workday Studio, dashboards, and BIRT reports
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and deliver actionable insights
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Workday Integrations and Workday Studio functionality
* Good experience in Workday integration, Workday report development, testing and validation

* You will also contribute to unit\-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers. If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
* Ability to develop value\-creating strategies and models that enable clients to innovate, drive growth and increase their business profitability
* Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
* Awareness of latest technologies and Industry trends
* Logical thinking and problem solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
* Understanding of the financial processes for various types of projects and the various pricing models available
* Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
* One or two industry domain knowledge
* Client Interfacing skills
* Project and Team management
